name: Admin Document State Episodes
description: Admin manages concurrent document-state episodes from the editor. Exclusive cycle states transition in either direction while additive signals coexist; each opening, close, removal and corrected effective date remains attributable in the timeline. Inline creation first suggests similar shared states. Closing or removing a state uses a contextual in-panel modal with an optional reason. Normalized observations can open Solucionar bug and automatically close or remove that linked episode when the last pending observation is resolved, discarded or deleted.
